Name: Expenses Web
Purpose: The ordinary confidential web application, assigned to a group rather than to people

Name: Payroll Console
Purpose: Assigned to the one-member group, so an access review that widens by one person is visible

Name: Partner Portal SPA
Purpose: A public client with no secret, which is the shape a review most often mistakes for a misconfiguration

Name: Field App
Purpose: A native client with a custom scheme redirect and a refresh token, which URL validation routinely rejects

Name: Wiki SAML
Purpose: SAML rather than OIDC, so anything that assumes every application has a client id has one that does not

Name: Legacy Console
Purpose: Disabled and assigned to nobody, which an inventory still has to list and a review still has to explain
